profile.headline: Software Engineer (Mobile App Developer) at UHC | React Native
profile.summary:
Mobile software engineer specializing in React Native development with experience delivering scalable, high-performance features for top-rated healthcare apps. I’ve led efforts that significantly improved user experience — including a 91.4% reduction in claims submission time and the launch of iOS-native features like Live Activities and Dynamic Island.

I also built a custom demo server and app environment that enabled Sales and Advocacy teams to showcase our product without relying on test users, while also streamlining internal development and QA workflows.

I work with modern tools (TypeScript, GitHub, CI/CD, Firebase) and thrive in fast-paced, cross-functional environments. I’ve partnered with design, product, and accessibility teams to deliver polished, user-centered mobile experiences.

Always open to chatting about mobile engineering, impactful product development, healthcare or opportunities to build great user experiences at scale. 

Skills
· Mobile Development: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, iOS Live Activities, Dynamic Island, Android Studio, Xcode, Mobile UI/UX, and Accessibility
· Applications: Tableau, Dynamics AX, Trello, Microsoft Office/Excel, JMP, Power BI Desktop and NetLogo
· Databases: SQL, NoSQL, Entity-Relationship Model, Relational Model and Database Management Systems 
· Programming: Python (fundamental computational modeling and simulation techniques; matplotlib; Jupyter Notebooks), MATLAB (analysis of experimental data and scientific modeling), R Studio, Fortran, LaTeX and GitHub

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Mobile App Developer for UHC (UnitedHealthcare) App; a top medical app on the iPhone App Store and Google Play Store.
· Led the migration of Live Person Chat for in-house employees, improving user experience and achieving an initial Net Promoter score of 100.
· Streamlined the claims process, reducing submission times by 91.4%.
· Integrated iOS Live Activities and Dynamic Island UI with background data updates using background fetch.
· Created pre-prompt permissions for notifications.
· Lead the Washington, D.C. site as a community lead to create programming for early career individuals to facilitate networking, and build relationships.
· Mentored incoming Technology Development Program Associates, providing guidance and support as they began their careers.

Praised by colleagues for:
· "Being amazing is Allissa's default"
· Exceptional Flexibility and Dedication - "Allissa, your flexibility is truly commendable. Throughout the various challenges we faced, you seamlessly transitioned between roles such as Developer, Project Manager, and QA. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities [Chat, Claims projects] and still deliver a high-quality result is truly impressive. Your hard work and dedication are greatly appreciated. Thank you."
· "Thank you for your dedication to delivering with quality. You consistently deliver quality results as an engineer and contribute so much to our member experience. You are also awesome to work with while doing it!"
· "I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere appreciation for the amazing job you did in putting together the collective sizzle reel. Your hard work, attention to detail, and ability to summarize the features so effectively within a short timeframe have resulted in a high-quality presentation that is ready to be shared with all. The demo video is not only comprehensive but also engaging, clearly reflecting your dedication and expertise. Thank you for your outstanding efforts."

positions.title: Technology Development Program Associate: Rotation 1 - Software Engineer, Rotation 2 - Data Science
positions.description:
· Designed and implemented automation scripts to replicate real user experience to test validity, functionality, and performance.
· Modified Curo Medical Management software application in an agile and fast environment with bi-weekly production release cycles, supporting a system with 1,000 users.
· Solved complex issues through creating integrated products.
· Ensured form validations for admission intake forms including diagnoses and dates, with functionality and user experience in mind.

positions.title: Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT)
positions.description:
· Support daily pharmacy operations, including medication compounding and dispensing. 
· Advocate for patients by helping navigate insurance issues and supporting medication access.
· Certified immunizing pharmacy technician, trained to administer vaccines. Administered 50+ vaccinations to patients following immunization protocols and safety procedures.

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician Trainee
positions.description: · Trained under licensed pharmacists to gain hands-on experience in medication preparation, dispensing, and pharmacy operations.

positions.title: Trilingual Language Officer
positions.locationName: Fairfax County, Virginia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
· Promote free and fair elections, using electronic poll books to process 1376 voters.
· Leverage Vietnamese and Korean language skills to improve inclusion for non-native English speakers.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
· Evaluated the strengths and weaknesses of 13 team members, 1 shift leader, and 1 manager to build strategies that will further enhance their skills.
· Navigated contract development and management with clients, negotiating all aspects of terms and conditions, pricing, and proprietary agreements for events; generated an extra revenue of $400-$1000 each time.
· Tracked sales using data from the point of sales system; remove items with low sales records from inventory to decrease inventory costs, increasing gross profits.
· Organized and facilitated meetings with an emphasis on goal setting and innovation.
· Served as a liaison between staff and management.
